en.bdb: The Creator is inaccessible for the creation

verses.gurmukhi: ਰੋਮ ਰੋਮ ਵਿਚਿ ਰਖਿਓਨੁ ਕਰਿ ਵਰਭੰਡ ਕਰੋੜਿ ਸਮਾਈ।
verses.translit_en: rom rom vich rakhion kar varabha(n)dd karoR samaiee|

en.bdb: In His one trichome He has subsumed crores of universes.

verses.gurmukhi: ਕੇਵਡੁ ਵਡਾ ਆਖੀਐ ਕਿਤੁ ਘਰਿ ਵਸੈ ਕੇਵਡੁ ਜਾਈ।
verses.translit_en: kevadd vaddaa aakheeaai kit ghar vasai kevadd jaiee|

en.bdb: What can be said about His expanse, His abode and the extent of His place?

verses.gurmukhi: ਇਕੁ ਕਵਾਉ ਅਮਾਉ ਹੈ ਲਖ ਦਰੀਆਉ ਨ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਪਾਈ।
verses.translit_en: eik kavaau amaau hai lakh dhareeaau na keemat paiee|

en.bdb: Even His one sentence is beyond all limits and its evaluation cannot be done by millions of rivers of knowledge.

verses.gurmukhi: ਪਰਵਦਗਾਰੁ ਅਪਾਰੁ ਹੈ ਪਾਰਾਵਾਰੁ ਨ ਅਲਖੁ ਲਖਾਈ।
verses.translit_en: paravadhagaar apaar hai paaraavaar na alakh lakhaiee|

en.bdb: That sustainer of the world is inaccessible; his beginning and end is imperceptible.

verses.gurmukhi: ਏਵਡੁ ਵਡਾ ਹੋਇ ਕੈ ਕਿਥੈ ਰਹਿਆ ਆਪੁ ਲੁਕਾਈ।
verses.translit_en: evadd vaddaa hoi kai kithai rahiaa aap lukaiee|

en.bdb: Being so much great where has He hidden Himself?

verses.gurmukhi: ਸੁਰ ਨਰ ਨਾਥ ਰਹੇ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ॥੮॥
verses.translit_en: sur nar naath rahe liv laiee ||8||

en.bdb: To know this, the gods, men and many a nath are ever in concentration upon Him.
